title: I keep dreaming about this huge, weird bathroom — what could it mean?
content: Usually, the dream starts with me panicking for some reason, and I start running, looking for somewhere safe. That’s when I find this huge bathroom. It’s not like a normal bathroom — it’s bright white everywhere, kind of sterile but also spacious. There are stalls, showers, and places to sit, but the stalls aren’t ordinary. They are cubby-like. They’re all rounded off, in different shapes and sizes — some huge, some tiny, some with multiple toilets, some with none. Most of them don’t have doors, but a few do. It feels chaotic but also strangely organized, like it’s designed to handle all sorts of people and situations at once. Even though I’m panicking at the start, there’s something almost calming about the openness and brightness… though I’m still overwhelmed. I remember this mostly from memory, so I don’t know if every detail is exactly the same each time, but the feeling and the structure are consistent.
